name: Cungeon
description:
About This Game

What Awaits You!

A special deck box accompanies you throughout the main campaign, teaches you the core gameplay mechanics, and also serves as home for the cards you collect.

Cards & Fusions

Fight your way through a dangerous dungeon, collect Spell and Monster cards, and rebuild your deck for every duel. Almost all cards can be fused together, creating completely new and unique cards that let you craft powerful combos and continuously improve your build. After each successful run, the next floor awaits with new waves of enemies, greater dangers, and bosses blocking your path.

Loot & Character Progression

In addition to cards, you will find loot that strengthens your character, allowing you to venture deeper into the dungeon and escape damnation. Unlock new archetypes, challenge stronger enemies, and prove your best run — your high score will be immortalized on the scoreboard.

The Dungeon

An ancient darkness hangs over the dungeon, consuming everything that ventures too deep. Each floor feels colder, stranger, and more threatening than the last, as if the abyss itself is watching from above. Flickering light, endless shadows, and the feeling of never truly being alone follow your every step. New dangers lurk around every corner, and the deeper you go, the stronger the sense that the dungeon is alive, breathing, and slowly trying to pull you into its damnation. Its grim atmosphere turns every run into a tense fight for survival, where hope and ruin are often only a single card apart.
short_desc: Dive into a roguelike adventure with procedurally generated dungeons and endless depths. Defeat monsters, collect card drops, and steadily expand and refine your deck. Cards can be fused and upgraded to create powerful combos and unique strategies.
